author: visegrad24
text:
At least 72 Christians have been killed in a series of attacks by ISIS in the Ituri Province of Congo, bringing the reported number of Christians killed in the province since mid-July to more than 200.

In the deadliest attack, Islamic State Central Africa Province (ISCAP) killed 29 Christians in the villages of Mabakoa and Biam. They also burned 40 homes, forcing hundreds of villagers to flee.

The following day, ISCAP fighters captured and beheaded 11 Christians in Amani.

The group has killed more than 1,370 Christians in northeastern DR Congo since December 2024.
